dedupe_keys.name: meteor tanzania seismic hazard map with mean peak ground acceleration pga in g for a 10 and 2 probability of exceedence in 50 years

description: The Global Earthquake Model Foundation publishes a Tanzania seismic-hazard grid from the METEOR exposure project. The Zenodo record gives an openly accessible ZIP under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. It describes an ASCII CSV with WGS84 latitude and longitude and mean peak ground acceleration for 10% and 2% exceedance probabilities in 50 years, sampled at 0.025-degree spacing. The map can supply earthquake intensity inputs to building, road and utility exposure simulations in Tanzania. It is a companion to the separately deposited Nepal METEOR seismic map, while no catalogue record explicitly covers the Tanzania layer. A limitation is that the values come from an OpenQuake/SSAHARA hazard model, not from measured damage or a future-event forecast. Ground conditions and model version may differ from a local engineering assessment. No archive was downloaded, and grid coverage and numeric values were not independently checked.
